text:
andrew: quick heads-up — after the kernel-selection swap last night we see host-side p50 fine but p99 tail up ~18% on short-chat workloads. root cause looks like tokenization + request parsing now dominating the host CPU slice :thinking_face:

sophie: do you have a flamegraph or pprof snapshot?

andrew: attaching top-line from a 5m perf run:
```
99.9% cpu samples: host-tokenize 42%, parse-request 26%, grpc-writev 8%, kvcache-evict 6%, kernel-selection 4%, other 14%
p99 increase correlated with many small requests (<30 tokens)
```

mike: that matches what we saw — kernel change optimized batching for long sequences, but short requests fall through to more host work. suspect proto unpack + UTF8 normalize path is hot.

andrew: exactly. also seeing many tiny gRPC frames (1-2 writes per response). syscall latency piles up. screenshots: smallwrites=72% of responses, avg write bytes=240

sophie: ugh. two angles: reduce host work (faster tokenizer path / pretokenized cache for small requests) and reduce syscall overhead (coalesce writev or buffer small frames).

lee: kvcache behavior note: pprof shows brief spike in evictions at the time-of-spike. TTL/size policy might be thrashing for these short sessions; possibly due to different KV keying after kernel swap (new route tag).

andrew: plan proposals:
- tokenization: add fast-path for ASCII-only short inputs and a small token pool to avoid reallocs (owner @sophie)
- request parsing: inline proto decode for top-3 request shapes, avoid full reflection path (owner @mike)
- streaming: introduce a small write coalescer on host edge that batches frames for 2-3ms or until buffer >= 1KB (owner @lee)
- KV cache: mark hot prefix keys as pinned with slightly higher capacity, raise eviction headroom (ops run)
- metrics: add per-route host parsing CPU and smallwrite ratio to Redwood Console

sophie: can we measure impact with a canary that flips the smallwrite coalescer only? lowest-risk.

andrew: yep. I'll open a canary PR that gates coalescer behind feature flag + telemetry. also will include a synthetic load sim for short chats.

mike: one more ask — add a kernel-selection fallback when sequence_length < 40 to pick short-seq kernel (even if slightly less efficient for long runs). should avoid the host-path storm.

lee: KV tweak: temp patch to bump cache size by 15% for 30m windows for canary run. watch kv.evictions and p99 host CPU.

deploy-bot: canary deploy scheduled: deploy/infra-service v2.18.3 -> canary group (flags: coalescer=false, kv-bump=true) :rocket:

andrew: starting perf capture against canary now, will post pprof + flamegraphs in ~10m. tagging @sophie @mike @lee :eyes:

sophie: nice. if coalescer helps we'll enable for real and follow with tokenizer fast-path. :thumbsup:

mike: ack — i'll draft inline proto patch and benchmark locally.

lee: i'll prepare dashboard widgets and alert on kv.evictions > 5%.
